questions.q: From the 'शब्द-अर्थ' box in the textbook, which word is defined as "किसी चीज़ को लेकर जुनून की हद तक चले जाने का भाव"?
questions.a: The correct answer is **विडम्बन** (vD[kM+iu). A wrong answer like "तर्कशीलता" reveals the student is matching words to definitions mechanically without grasping the emotional intensity "विडम्बन" carries in the poem's context - the father's obsessive need to protect his children from urban corruption.

questions.q: In the line "हक़्सियत की मस्जिद / रहज़न की एँड़ी", the word "एँड़ी" (heel) is used metaphorically. Explain why the poet chooses "heel" rather than "foot" or "step" to represent the oppressor.
questions.a: "एँड़ी" conveys casual, thoughtless cruelty - the heel grinds without intent, just by walking. A student answering "foot shows power" misses the nuance: the poem critiques systemic oppression that doesn't even notice what it crushes. This misunderstanding shows inability to analyze connotation vs denotation.

questions.q: The poem uses "मेहन" (affection) in the compound "फक़्सम+लक मेहन" (thick-layered affection). Apply the concept of समास-विग्रह to explain how the compound word's meaning differs from "मेहन" alone.
questions.a: "फक़्सम+लक मेहन" = "फक़्सम+लक" (thick layers) + "मेहन" (affection) = layered, accumulated affection over generations. "मेहन" alone suggests simple love; the compound adds historical depth and weight. A student writing "same meaning" fails to see how समास compresses the joint family's generational bond into one word.

questions.q: Compare the contextual meanings of "नक़्श" in these two lines from the poem: (1) "बाँह गलती फिरनी में / ठहु की बाँह गलती" and (2) "जीवन की झेगझगव". How does the same root concept of "imprint" function differently?
questions.a: In (1) "नक़्श" is physical - cream imprint on milk, domestic, nurturing. In (2) it's metaphysical - life's imprint on the soul, existential, scarring. The shift from tactile to traumatic mirrors the poem's arc from village warmth to urban alienation. A student giving identical meanings misses the poem's central movement.

questions.q: The textbook defines "लक़्सेखिउ" as "संवेदनशीलता" (sensitivity). Evaluate whether this definition is sufficient for the line "उफ़्न;क क फुएज़्र्क" where the word appears. Justify your evaluation.
questions.a: The definition is necessary but insufficient. In context, "लक़्सेखिउ" carries gendered pain - women's silent endurance of joint family burdens. "संवेदनशीलता" is neutral; the poem's usage is specifically feminine and sacrificial. A student saying "definition is perfect" shows inability to evaluate lexical gaps between dictionary and literary usage.

questions.q: Create a two-line Hindi couplet (दोहा/मुक्तक) using "वक़्स-गोक", "मेहन", and "नक़्श" that captures the poem's theme of vanishing rural intimacy. Each word must carry its poem-specific connotation.
questions.a: Example: "वक़्स-गोक टूटे जब मेहन के नक़्श गहरे / शहर की धूप में छाँव बनी फिर ना बहरे।" A poor answer uses words decoratively without the tension between deep sleep (innocence) and urban harshness. This reveals whether the student has internalized the words' thematic resonance.
